public_training.provider_regression_guard: Each provider validation normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2% versus seasonal naive; select smallest qualified provider-balanced normalized MAE
public_training.validation_target: Provider-specific geographic and terminal-time validation; Uzbekistan January-December 2025 is legacy development validation
public_training.test_protocol: Fresh independent international geographic plus terminal-year holdout is constructed explicitly only after model freeze; previous Uzbekistan and synthetic test outcomes are legacy regression benchmarks.
public_training.selection_metric: Provider-balanced macro per-history-normalized validation MAE; training loss weight equal by provider; no final test outcomes used

abs.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
abs.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
abs.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
abs.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

statcan.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
statcan.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
statcan.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
statcan.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

public_training.temporal_scope: Holdouts are provider-local terminal years; Uzbekistan training through December 2025 overlaps some Australian/Canadian holdout dates. No absolute year, provider identity or cross-country shock covariates are features; this is not a globally chronological unseen-future test.
public_training.limitations: Original retail turnover and service value are aggregate revenue proxies, not independent firm cash receipts. Native currency units remain separate and only dimensionless errors are pooled. Survey revisions, correlated economic shocks, Uzbekistan short post-methodology histories, and cross-country aggregate-to-borrower transfer limit claims. No real costs, defaults or repayments are supplied.

metric_policy: MAE in declared million UZS is for real aggregates only; normalized MAE divides each window by its positive historical mean so districts, regions and sectors share a scale. MAPE excludes zero actuals and is unstable near zero; neither test metric selects the model.
scope: Actual licensed revenue/service volume; no real borrower expenses, capacity, repayment or default labels. The original 2020–22/2023/2024–25 retail temporal benchmark remains separate and unchanged.
vintage_caveat: A single current provider vintage may revise older observations. Target-date boundaries are enforced, but this is not a backtest with historical unrevised vintages. The service definition changed in September 2024; only October 2024 onward is used, excluding the incomparable September increment.
